title: cyperus overlaetii
intro: Cyperus overlaetii, commonly known as the 'Dwarf Papyrus', is a species of sedge in the family Cyperaceae. This aquatic plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus overlaetii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The plant's extracts have also been found to possess neuroprotective and anti-diabetic activities, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
